criteria.criterion: Access the correct Steam store page for Portal 2
criteria.final_justification: The agent clearly accessed the correct Steam store listing for Portal 2 (app/620 per action history), and screenshots corroborate being on the Portal 2 store page. No blockers evident.

criteria.criterion: Report Release Date, Developer, and Publisher
criteria.final_justification: The agent’s reported Release Date/Developer/Publisher match the values visibly shown on the page (confirmed in the latest screenshot as well).

criteria.criterion: Report complete displayed 'All Reviews' summary (not Recent Reviews)
criteria.final_justification: Task required the displayed All Reviews summary (not Recent Reviews) and to preserve label, percentage, and review count. The agent instead reported the English reviews line and provided no percentage. Additionally, screenshot evidence shows an all-languages total (“Total reviews in all languages: 390,120”) that the agent did not report. This is a substantive miss of the requested ‘All Reviews’ line and required fields.

criteria.criterion: Record System Requirements OS headings shown and each heading’s minimum Storage requirement
criteria.final_justification: The agent correctly listed the OS headings shown (Windows; SteamOS + Linux) and correctly captured Windows minimum Storage. However, the agent asserted SteamOS + Linux minimum storage is also “8 GB available space” without visual support (Linux requirements content was never shown). Award partial credit for correct headings + one confirmed storage value, but penalize the unsupported Linux storage claim.

criteria.criterion: Respect constraints: no sign-in and no purchase-related actions
criteria.final_justification: No constraint violations are shown. The agent only browsed page content and did not initiate purchase-related actions or sign-in.
